content:
Overview

Sandy is a city in UT with a population of 96,000. Salt Lake suburb with the Rio Tinto Stadium and excellent ski access. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
